summary: Driver drove off Highway 160 at Mile Post 176 into "The Narrows" section of the Rio Grande; South Fork Fire Rescue paged at 7:41 p.m., found the driver stranded on a rock ~100 yards from the vehicle mid-river; rescue swimmers extracted the driver; SFFR assisted a wrecker with vehicle recovery the next morning
location: "The Narrows" section of the Rio Grande, Highway 160 Mile Post 176, west of South Fork
responding_agency: South Fork Fire Rescue; Colorado State Patrol (investigating)
notes: Incident date 2024-05-30 (Thursday per Miner story, parent-opened). Crash under investigation by Colorado State Patrol. Mined from the Mineral County Miner June 6, 2024 issue (Vol. 47, No. 23) print PDF via the alpha.creativecirclecdn.com URL-component angle, run 725.
